create_sana_pipeline_config: create a SanaPipelineConfig for text-to-image generation with Gemma2 text encoder and DC-AE VAE
run_sana_postprocess_text: run sana_postprocess_text to extract the final hidden state from a Gemma2 encoder output as a tensor
build_prepare_latent_shape: build the 4D latent shape (B, C, H', W') for SANA using batch dimensions and VAE compression ratio
test_prepare_pos_cond_kwargs: test prepare_pos_cond_kwargs to extract encoder_attention_mask from batch prompt data for positive conditioning
review_shard_latents_for_sp: review shard_latents_for_sp which returns latents unmodified since SANA DiT does not support sequence sharding
